info.title: Asaptic Sourcing API
info.description: Agent-facing interface to Asaptic (HK) Ltd — factory-direct, deposit-first sourcing of certified clinical devices and deep-tech components for Western and Global-South B2B buyers, plus a free public cross-market tender listing feed (sanitized trilingual summaries). Live endpoints: GET /api/v1/tenders (+ /{at_id}, /facets), GET /agent/capabilities.json, POST /mcp (MCP JSON-RPC). Listing access is keyless; spec-coded technical packages are account-gated. A REST /rfq endpoint is planned.

get.summary: Public cross-market tender listing feed (sanitized trilingual summaries). Keyless. Default excludes rows whose closing window has passed.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Comma-separated two-letter market codes, e.g. HK,SG

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug or name (en/zh/zht), comma-separated. Vocabulary: /api/v1/tenders/facets

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: Only rows new in the current issue

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring search over the sanitized summaries and category names only

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Collapse each row to one language

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Cursors are bound to one listing issue: a stale cursor returns 409 snapshot_changed — restart from the first page.

200.description: Envelope {data: TenderRow[], meta: {total, returned, next_cursor, issue_id, generated, snapshot_etag, access}}

409.description: snapshot_changed — the listing issue rotated since the cursor was minted

get.summary: One public listing row by Asaptic id (AT-…). Ids not present in the current public snapshot return an identical 404.
Listing facet vocabulary and counts: markets, categories (with slugs), closing buckets, value bands.
Feed health and freshness: {status, rows_total, issue_id, generated, feed_fresh, schema}. Alias: GET /healthz. Never cached.
Spec-coded technical packages are gated. This public endpoint always returns 403 SPEC_CODED_GATED with the access path (portal account or request_tender_access on /mcp).

200.description: Capabilities document (lanes, markets, compliance, deposit-first model)

post.summary: MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP). Tools: list_sourcing_lanes, get_lane_capability, get_engagement, submit_rfq, list_tenders, get_tender, tender_facets, get_spec_coded, request_tender_access.
Submit a request for quote (PLANNED REST endpoint; today use POST /mcp tools/call submit_rfq).

TenderRow.description: asaptic.tender.v1 — a verbatim row from the public listing snapshot. Rows carry sanitized summaries and bucketed metadata only — always exactly these fields, never more.

product.description: Product or lane (e.g. 'TFLN wafers', 'clinical bioimpedance device')

target_market.description: ISO country or region (e.g. US, EU, CA, AU, Saudi, Brazil)

buyer_contact.description: Email or contact for Asaptic to respond (within 4 hours)
